queries: WITH overall AS (SELECT AVG(UnitPrice) AS avg_price FROM Track), by_media_type AS (SELECT m.MediaTypeId, AVG(t.UnitPrice) AS avg_price FROM MediaType AS m LEFT JOIN Track AS t ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId) SELECT b.MediaTypeId, b.avg_price AS average_track_unit_price, b.avg_price / NULLIF(o.avg_price, 0) AS price_ratio FROM by_media_type AS b CROSS JOIN overall AS o ORDER BY price_ratio IS NULL, price_ratio DESC, b.MediaTypeId LIMIT 10;

WITH overall AS (SELECT AVG(UnitPrice) AS average_price FROM Track) SELECT m.MediaTypeId, AVG(t.UnitPrice) AS average_track_unit_price, AVG(t.UnitPrice) / NULLIF(o.average_price, 0) AS ratio_to_overall FROM MediaType AS m LEFT JOIN Track AS t ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId CROSS JOIN overall AS o GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, o.average_price ORDER BY ratio_to_overall IS NULL, ratio_to_overall DESC LIMIT 10;

WITH overall AS (SELECT AVG(UnitPrice) AS overall_average_track_price FROM Track), per_media AS (SELECT m.MediaTypeId, AVG(t.UnitPrice) AS average_track_unit_price FROM MediaType AS m LEFT JOIN Track AS t ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId) SELECT p.MediaTypeId, p.average_track_unit_price, o.overall_average_track_price, p.average_track_unit_price / NULLIF(o.overall_average_track_price, 0) AS ratio FROM per_media AS p CROSS JOIN overall AS o ORDER BY ratio IS NULL, ratio DESC, p.MediaTypeId LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: Include every ID in MediaType, even if it has no tracks; its average and ratio are then NULL.
